NexusAppSettings.NexusKeyExampleNote: The checked-in staging Nexus key material is an example only and is forbidden from use in all environments (including tests). Override it with secret configuration before running.
NexusAppSettings.NexusKeyFormatNote: Format is omitted intentionally. NexusKey defaults to ByteEncoding.Utf8, so this 32-character sample string is used as 32 raw UTF-8 bytes and is not hex-decoded.
NexusAppSettings.NexusKeyAlternativeFormatNote: Alternative NexusKey formats: Hex, Base64, or Base64UrlEncoded; decoded bytes must be exactly 32.

DrnAppFeatures.SeedKeyNote: This staging example uses the sample SeedKey for app security defaults in test configurations. Live staging deployments must override this with a secret SeedKey before running outside tests; the sample SeedKey is forbidden outside test execution.
